description: This file defines the class AndroidImplicitUsagesProvider, which implements ImplicitUsageProvider to identify implicit usages of Android-related PSI elements in IntelliJ IDEA plugin development.

classes.name: AndroidImplicitUsagesProvider
classes.description: Implements ImplicitUsageProvider to detect implicit usages of Android-related PSI elements.

methods.name: isImplicitUsage
methods.description: Determines if a PSI element is implicitly used.

methods.name: isImplicitParameterUsage
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is implicitly used in Android click handler methods.

methods.name: isImplicitFieldUsage
methods.description: Checks if a field like 'CREATOR' is implicitly used, especially for Parcelable classes.

methods.name: isImplicitRead
methods.description: Always returns false; not used for implicit read detection.

methods.name: isImplicitWrite
methods.description: Checks if a field is implicitly written, e.g., resource references.

methods.name: isResourceReference
methods.description: Determines if a PsiAnnotationMemberValue is a resource reference to R class.
